title.text: Power Plant Operators, Distributors, and Dispatchers

subject.name: Power Plant Operators, Distributors, and Dispatchers
subject.summary: This page corresponds to the BLS SOC 51-8010 combined statistical group for power plant operators, distributors, and dispatchers, covering nuclear power reactor operators 51-8011, power distributors and dispatchers 51-8012, and power plant operators 51-8013. The three job types control nuclear reactors, coordinate power transmission and distribution, and run generating units respectively, and the combined group's wages or employment change cannot be treated as any single sub-occupation. Real equipment operation follows each organization's training and authorization.
